cards.card_text: Pharaoh places Joseph over all the land of Egypt, then pulls the signet ring off his own finger and puts it on Joseph's.
cards.verse_text: Pharaoh also told Joseph, “I hereby place you over all the land of Egypt.” Then Pharaoh removed the signet ring from his finger, put it on Joseph’s finger, clothed him in garments of fine linen, and placed a gold chain around his neck.

cards.card_text: King Xerxes says a decree written in his name and sealed with his signet ring can be revoked.
cards.verse_text: Now you may write in the king’s name as you please regarding the Jews, and seal it with the royal signet ring.

cards.card_text: The LORD swears it: "As surely as I live…" Then He says what He'd do even if Coniah were a signet ring on His right hand.
cards.verse_text: “As surely as I live,” declares the LORD, “even if you, Coniah son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, were a signet ring on My right hand, I would pull you off.
